title: Bill Gates says to prepare for 20 years of ‘tumultuous’ AI disruption
hook_text: Bill Gates predicts twenty years of AI disruption
script:
Bill Gates expects twenty years of tumultuous AI disruption ahead.
The Microsoft cofounder published an essay titled The turbulent AI era in late August.
He has spent months on tour discussing policy and regulation for OpenAI and Anthropic models.
Gates warns that rapid labor shifts will strain society before systems stabilize.
Would you change careers because of AI?
